about.title: About us
paragraphs: Founded in 2009 by Viktor Sokolov, Vitality Logistics moves freight across the Gulf by sea, road and air.
Our head office is in Business Bay, Dubai. Our warehouse in Jebel Ali handles over 400 containers a week.

figures.label: containers a week through Jebel Ali
the year our first truck left the yard

story.text: Viktor Sokolov starts Vitality Logistics in Dubai with a single truck.
Our first sea freight contracts: containers through Jebel Ali to ports across the GCC.
We open our own warehouse and container yard in Jebel Ali.
Head office moves to the 12th floor of Bay Square, Business Bay.
More than 120 people, and over 400 containers a week.

services.name: Sea freight
services.text: Full and shared containers from Jebel Ali to every major port in the GCC.

services.name: Road freight
services.text: Daily trucking across the UAE, with regular runs to Oman and Saudi Arabia.

services.name: Air freight
services.text: Urgent cargo booked through Dubai's airports, door to door.

services.name: Warehousing
services.text: Storage, pick and pack, and container handling at our Jebel Ali yard.

sites.name: Head office
sites.text: Sales, Finance, IT, HR and the Executive Office, on the 12th floor. Visitors check in at the lobby kiosk.

sites.name: Warehouse and yard
sites.text: Where containers are unloaded, stored and sent on, six days a week.

items.headline: Statement on this week's security incidents
items.text: This week Vitality Logistics was the target of several criminal incidents at our Jebel Ali warehouse and our head office. We have reported them to the authorities, and the police cybercrime unit is now investigating. We are cooperating fully. Our CEO, Viktor Sokolov, is personally overseeing our response. Operations continue as normal.
